notes:
Modern Quilt Designer 0.6.0 Preview adds true on-point quilt layouts.

- Alternate long and short rows of whole blocks in a rectangular quilt.
- Add side/corner setting triangles, diagonal sashing and cornerstones.
- Use the same exact geometry for the preview, cutting quantities, fabric requirements and calibrated PDF templates.
- Get labeled layout references, grain guidance, rounded-up starter squares and trim instructions.
- Save and reopen the new layouts while retaining older project formats and the legacy rotated-grid setting.

In Design, choose Setting → On point · diagonal rows, or use Quilt → On Point (diagonal rows). New layouts require square blocks. Returning to a straight grid keeps the long rows; Undo restores the previous layout. New on-point projects use format 6 and require this version to reopen.

To update an existing copy: Help → Check for Updates → Preview / Development → Check for updates → Download & install. Save your project when prompted. The updater verifies the signed installer before installing and restarting.

This is a preview release. Variable-size/freeform layout editors and machine-cutting output are later work. Print templates at Actual Size and measure the one-inch calibration square. Windows Authenticode signing is not yet available; updater signature verification is included.
